nodes.label: Transilvania Motor Ring (circuit, Cerghid, Romania)
nodes.rationale: 3.708 km clockwise circuit at 46.43528N 24.42694E, opened November 2018, largest racing venue in Romania. OSM way 488429454 (centerline, 150 nodes, ~3706 m) and way 488429716 (pit lane) are the geometry source; official start/finish, pit, and sector definitions are not publicly available.
